intro: Liechtenstein is one of the richest countries in the world, with a surprising amount of industry.

chapters.title: Tools and teeth
text: Hilti makes power tools sold worldwide, and Liechtenstein is one of the biggest makers of false teeth. Banking and finance are also important.

chapters.title: Companies
text: More companies are registered in Liechtenstein than there are people, many for tax reasons.

cardGroups.title: Made in Liechtenstein
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Liechtenstein makes and sells to the world.
